g.text: PORz ANDing logic AND gate supply is connected to
VCC_3V3_SYS. This is within the PORz fail-safe input
and PMIC1_GPIO (5 output signals) have been
filter near to the SOC PORz input
near to the ANDing logic AND gate
Not connecting a valid PORz input
is not getting a valid reset, internal
circuits could be in random states.
Slow rising reset signal could cause
glitches internal to the SOC reset
Use a discrete buffer and have the
fast rising output of the buffer drive
Open drain output type IO EXTINTn has slew rate
limit specified when pulled to 3.3V supply. An
RC is recommended at the input. Refer TMDS64EVM.
Processor LVCMOS IOS (inputs) have slew rate requirement
A Schmitt trigger based debouncing logic is recommended for the
slow ramp pushbutton output (+ RC) connected to the processor
Debouncing logic is recommended when push button + RC or RC is
